Sultan vs State Of U.P. Thru. Its Secy. Deptt. Of ... on 3 July, 
2024 
Author: Sangeeta Chandra
Bench: Sangeeta Chandra
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
?Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc-Lko:45129-Db
Court No. - 3
Case :- Writ - C No. - 5765 of 2024
Petitioner :- Sultan
Respondent :- State Of U.P. Thru. Its Secy. Deptt. Of Food Safety And Drug Administratio 
Counsel for Petitioner :- Shikhar Chaube,Akshya Tiwari,Saurabh Singh Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.,Anil Kumar Tripathi Hon'ble Mrs. Sangeeta Chandra,J.
Hon'ble Shree Prakash Singh,J.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner, learned Standing Counsel for the State-respondents and Sri Anil Kumar Tripathi, learned counsel for the respondent no.3. 
This petition has been filed with the following main prayer:-
"(I) Issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of mandamus commanding &
directing the opposite party no.4 to consider and decide the representation dated 11.03.2024, as contained in Annexure No.1 to this writ petition, within a short and reasonable time as prescribed by this Hon'ble Court, in the interest of justice." 
Sultan vs State Of U.P. Thru. Its Secy . Deptt . Of ... on 3 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/30152859/
1 It is the case of the petitioner that the petitioner has applied for a license to run a meat shop for which NOC is required to be given by Superintendent of Police, Gonda/Station House Officer concerned. 
This writ petition is disposed of with a direction to opposite party no.4 to consider the application made by the petitioner for grant of NOC and pass an appropriate reasoned and speaking order within a period of two weeks from the date a certified copy of this order is produced before him. 
Order Date :- 3.7.2024 Rahul  Sultan vs State Of U.P. Thru. Its Secy . Deptt . Of ... on 3 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/30152859/
